outcome: Time to resumption of sexual activity
cohort: 116 primiparous women who gave birth between January 1 and June 30, 2019.
finding: Instrumental delivery and perineal damage (episiotomy or tearing) had a negative impact on female sexuality.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth vaginally had better memory of childbirth compared to cesarean section; instrumental delivery by forceps was associated with dyspareunia; damage to the perineum had a negative impact on sexual function.
